versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the "gateway-restore" skill.
- Allows fast rollback of gateway configuration to the last known-good state via slash command or natural language.
- Supports tagging the current config as known-good for future restores.
- Automatically restarts the gateway with health checks and can roll back again if restart fails.
- Slash command `/restore` is handled automatically; natural language requests execute the restore script directly.
